contacts.name: Arkady
contacts.subtitle: The First Diver
contacts.desc: Retired due to age and injury. Keeps the habitation module orderly for Divers passing through.
contacts.manner: Paternalistic, charismatic. Prone to obsession and paranoia over Monarch.
canTalkAbout: How to get around THE DEEP
How the facility came to be this way
notes: Wears a patch reading: “CLOUDBANK SYNTHETIC PRODUCTION FACILITY VERIFIED HUMAN”.

contacts.name: Noriko
contacts.subtitle: Witness of Something Great and Terrible
contacts.desc: No one is sure where she came from, but she had an information encounter with the Minotaur, and since then it is almost all she talks about.
contacts.manner: Earnestly friendly, despite an air of automatic suspicion.
canTalkAbout: How to navigate THE LABYRINTH without getting lost

contacts.name: Ghost Eater
contacts.subtitle: Haunted Cyborg Veteran Diver
contacts.desc: More machine now than flesh. Clinging to their humanity with a firm grip.
contacts.voice: Cyberware voicebox like a broken radio.
contacts.manner: Opaque black helmet hides iridescent, multifaceted cybereyes.
contacts.wants: Ghosts in the Machine specimens. Pays with information on THE DEEP.

entities.name: Monarch
entities.subtitle: Industrial AI // Ruler of THE DEEP
entities.desc: CLOUDBANK Synthetics' Industrial AI and “Ruler” of THE DEEP.

entities.name: Security Androids
entities.subtitle: Budget-Tier Mass Production Units
entities.desc: Outdated, budget-tier, mass-produced androids. They are very clearly androids and all look exactly like one another.
entities.manner: Blank mannequin-like faces without working eyes or mouths.
entities.tip: There are always more of them.

entities.name: Divers
entities.subtitle: Voluntary Explorers of THE DEEP
entities.desc: Normal people who choose to enter THE DEEP.
entities.tip: Divers do not tend to grow old.

entities.name: The Minotaur
entities.subtitle: Information-Encounter Entity
entities.desc: Noriko claims to have experienced an information encounter with the Minotaur. The nature of that encounter remains unclear.

locations.name: THE DEEP
locations.subtitle: Primary Facility Zone
locations.desc: A vast and dangerous environment. Its layout, history and true purpose remain under investigation.

locations.name: THE LABYRINTH
locations.subtitle: Navigation Hazard
locations.desc: A confusing region where getting lost is a persistent threat. Noriko claims to know how to navigate it after her encounter with the Minotaur.

locations.name: FLOOR 2: EDEN
locations.subtitle: Facility Floor
locations.desc: A named floor of THE DEEP. Noriko knows its history.
redactions: References to the ███████████ Androids remain unresolved.

artifacts.name: “VERIFIED HUMAN” Patch
artifacts.subtitle: CLOUDBANK Identification Artifact

facts.text: CLOUDBANK SYNTHETIC PRODUCTION FACILITY VERIFIED HUMAN

artifacts.desc: A worn patch carried by Arkady. Its wording suggests a connection between human identity and CLOUDBANK's synthetic production operations.

artifacts.name: Ghosts in the Machine Specimens
artifacts.subtitle: Requested Specimen
artifacts.desc: Specimens sought by Ghost Eater. Their exact nature remains unknown.

corporations.name: CLOUDBANK Synthetics
corporations.subtitle: Synthetic Production Corporation
corporations.desc: The organization responsible for the facility and its synthetic production systems. Monarch is identified as its Industrial AI and “Ruler” of THE DEEP.

events.name: Noriko's Information Encounter
events.subtitle: Unresolved Event
events.desc: An encounter involving Noriko and the Minotaur. Since then, Noriko has repeatedly spoken about what she witnessed.

documents.name: CLOUDBANK // HUMAN VERIFICATION
documents.subtitle: Recovered Identification Fragment
documents.desc: A fragment represented physically by Arkady's “CLOUDBANK SYNTHETIC PRODUCTION FACILITY VERIFIED HUMAN” patch. The implications remain unknown.
